thread:
raj: seeing spikes and p99 stalls on multi-gpu jobs in eu-west yesterday evening, a few allreduce jobs hung and then recovered after 30-60s. anyone else?

emma: yep noticed similar in the job queue. p99 token latency jumped and NCCL logs show repeated 'transport error' and 'p2p timeout' on rank 2->3.

sasha: infra-bot alerted us for RoCE packet-loss on tor-12 around 20:12 UTC. counters show RX drop bursts on port 8/9.

infra-bot: [ALERT] 2242103200 - rocev-loss-rate > 0.5% (5m) on leaf-tor-12.port8. Related jobs: gpu-pool-euwest-3.

ben: any config changes rolled out? kernel, mtu, offloads?

raj: we rolled a kernel back on a subset of hosts for a driver test ~19:50 but that was limited to 6 nodes. MTU and offload config should be unchanged.

emma: I grabbed ibv logs from the failing host pair:
```
[2024-11-03T20:12:34Z] ibv_reg_mr failed: -22
[2024-11-03T20:12:35Z] qp timeout (last native_ack 0x2)
[2024-11-03T20:12:36Z] p2p operation aborted, retrying
```
also saw VF bounce messages in dmesg: `mlx5_core 0000:86:00.1: virtual function 1 bounce`

sasha: VF bounce + mr reg errors could point to VF reset or SR-IOV flapping. did we have any PCI resets?

ben: switch counters:
```
leaf-tor-12# show interface eth1/8 counters
Rx drops: 318
Rx errors: 0
Tx drops: 4
```
Also saw an ECMP path shift event in the fabric control logs at 20:11:50.

raj: hmm ECMP shift + VF bounce could cause packets to traverse a different ToR with mismatched MTU / offload settings -> PMTU blackhole for RoCE frames.

emma: I ran `ethtool -k` on both compute NICs, got: `tx-checksum-ip-generic: on, tx-vlan-offload: on, rx-vlan-offload: on, rx-rss: on`. MTU on server NICs is 9000. On the leaf ports it's 9216 somehow.

sasha: there's the mismatch. 9000 vs 9216 can fragment RoCE/UDP-GRE payloads and some switches drop larger frames depending on offload behavior. Also some firmware versions treat 9216 specially.

ben: for repro I started `ibv_rc_pingpong` across the pair while causing a controlled route update (simulate ECMP path change). I see a 30-80ms burst then p2p errors.

raj: short-term: pin the job routing to the original ToR (use ip rule to prefer current path) and force MTU to 9216 on the compute NICs to match switch config. Can ops do that for the affected hosts?

emma: I'll push a quick netlink script to set MTU to 9216 on the 8 nodes in pool euwest-3. will coordinate maintenance window.

sasha: also let's disable SR-IOV VF auto-recovery on those NICs (keep PF in control) until we have a firmware/driver root cause. VF reset seems correlated.

ben: opened a ticket with vendor: case #VND-9981, attached ibv, dmesg, switch counters. Asked for FW check for 9216 handling + VF reset bug.

infra-bot: [RUNBOOK] For suspected PMTU blackhole with RoCE: 1) compare MTU on NIC, ToR, spine. 2) look for ECMP/route churn. 3) check VF/pf resets in dmesg. 4) capture pcap with `tcpdump -i any -w /tmp/roce.pcap udp and port 4791`.

raj: long-term: we should enforce MTU uniformity in provisioning and add a preflight check in node bootstrap that verifies NIC MTU == leaf MTU and flags mismatches. also add a fabric alert correlation rule for ECMP changes + rx drops.

emma: agree. I'll file an infra change: add preflight MTU check + drift alert. also propose a small test during autoscaling that runs `ibv_rc_pingpong` smoke test between new nodes and an existing host.

sasha: for completeness, can we also dump `mlx5_core` firmware versions across the fleet? I'll collect with a one-liner and compare.

ben: logging vendor response here once they reply.

raj: thanks all. immediate next steps: (1) emma set MTU -> 9216 on the 8 hosts, (2) sasha disable VF auto-recovery on those NICs, (3) ben follow vendor case, (4) infra-bot create alert correlation. report back when done. :thumbsup:
